name: wec-lc
description: WorldWide English College, London Campus — public site (static, no framework) + backend (Cloudflare Pages Functions, no npm runtime dependencies).
comment_on_modules: No root-level "type" field, deliberately: scripts/build.js (the existing static-site generator) is CommonJS, while functions/**/*.js (Pages Functions) use ES module import/export. Node 22's built-in CJS/ESM syntax auto-detection handles both correctly from one tree without a type field — verified by running both. Do not add "type": "module" here without also converting scripts/build.js, or it breaks the static build.
comment_on_engines: scripts/build.js alone would run on much older Node, but `npm test` needs 22+ for node:sqlite (see tests/README.md) — the honest minimum for full local development, not just the static build.

scripts.arabic: node scripts/build-arabic.js && node scripts/build-arabic-levels.js && node scripts/build.js
scripts.comment_on_provisioning: db:provision is the one to run. db:schema loads the tables and seeds six EMPTY course shells; the 60 modules, 294 learning items and 660 quiz questions live in sql/seed-curriculum-level-1..6.sql, which sixteen build and publication scripts read and which provisioning did not. A College set up with db:schema alone hands its first paying learner a programme page with nothing inside it. scripts/provision-db.mjs loads both and then checks, level by level, that modules actually arrived.
scripts.curriculum: node --experimental-sqlite scripts/publication/render-flagship.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite scripts/publication/render-curriculum-docx.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite scripts/publication/render-specs.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite scripts/publication/render-bible.mjs
scripts.curriculum:editions: npm run curriculum:student && npm run curriculum:institutional
scripts.comment_on_masterplan: The Ten-Year Institutional Roadmap. The model is scripts/publication/masterplan.mjs and it is the single source: the PDF and the workbook are two renderings of one computation, so they cannot disagree. tests/masterplan.test.mjs runs the reconciliation audit the plan claims in its own Section 20.
scripts.comment_on_monograph: The flagship monograph. Its art direction lives in scripts/publication/monograph.mjs and its four typefaces are embedded by fetch-fonts.mjs — the publication previously asked for Cambria, Nimbus Roman and Georgia, none of which exist on the machine that renders it, so every version was set in a fallback nobody chose. The renderer FAILS the build if any page overflows, clips at the trim, or sets text on top of text.
scripts.comment_on_board_edition: The WEC-LC Ten-Year Institutional Master Plan, Board & Investment Edition. Built from zero (CLAUDE.md §8): the model is scripts/plan/, reading only data/plan/, and the book is composed from one solved run of it. The renderer pours the book into pages in the browser and fails the build if any page overflows, clips, sets text on text, misnumbers itself, carries a photograph or sets a word its ground makes unreadable.
